CustomField.description: Written by: whoever proposes. Read by: the evidence-family law. Which family of evidence this row rests on, and therefore which shape it must have: Transcript needs a Source and spans, State needs neither and needs cited rows instead, Both needs everything. Ruled 47, 1 Aug 2026. Not required at field level on purpose: candidates written before the field exists must stay updatable, and the law is enforced on insert by AAO_EvidenceFamily rather than by the schema, so that a refusal can explain itself.
CustomField.label: Basis
